coordination_incident: The original amended descriptor and its readiness authorized the same ordered twelve-path scope.
A BUS seam audit reopened a MAJOR because runtime_group_heads used local Group identity instead of (graph_id, group_id, group_version).
The descriptor was changed to the reopened digest while the coder, already operating under the root repair instruction, had edited in-scope migration 014 and focused tests.
Before observing descriptor drift, the coder completed the in-scope Stage-E manifest, local pilot and execution receipt refresh, then stopped before changing the execution-receipt.sha256 sidecar.

A subsequent red-team probe found a second MAJOR: the harness closure validates run_id and graph_id independently but does not prove inside the transaction that confirmed_turn_graphs(graph_id).run_id equals requested run_id; Run-A with Graph-B was accepted and advanced Group-B.
No promotion follows from the raced writes or the current green suite; this amendment issues bounded authority to close both findings and regenerate evidence.

Prove both Run-A/Graph-B and Run-B/Graph-A reject with zero journal rows and zero Run/Group head mutation, while matching pairs remain valid.
Rerun the complete validation_commands matrix, regenerate all affected Stage-E evidence and obtain a fresh independent red-team PASS.
